title: When the Kitchen Turns Again
author: Ulyana Voss
blurb: Ines Winterbourne, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
